Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra and Yoshimaru.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

513-3652-4336.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

141-1070-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-2034.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3249-4289-6248--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6248--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3532-3536-5078-7864.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1322-1409-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4871-5256-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4871-5256-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

847-1459-1636-3908.description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Spark Double enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Spark Double trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
847-1459-1636-3908.notes: Once you have extra mana, you can choose the other modes of Galadriel. You can also blink other creatures using Gilraen.

1368-1753-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1753-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1267-3967-4034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-3967-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

2724-3194-6568.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Y'shtola Rhul. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1719-2628-6185-7412.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1719-2628-6185-7412.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Pharika's Mender.
When Pharika's Mender enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2617-2781-7150.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Felidar Guardian's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 4.

622-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-2292-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

338-3490-4659-5870.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pestermite.
When Pestermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2871-4146-6898.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

6701-6798--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6701-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4968-6593-6774.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Loading Zone.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-6593-6774.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

252-2073-5330--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

3903-3958-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
3903-3958-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Moderation to an opponent and drawing a card.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

2835-5256-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2835-5256-6249--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1308-3334-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.

372-3742-3908.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Spark Double to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Phantom Steed.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Spark Double leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Spark Double leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2136-3924-4688.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
2136-3924-4688.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Deep Forest Hermit.
When the Deep Forest Hermit tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating twenty 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, Orthion triggers, causing you to sacrfiice the Deep Forest Hermit tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

4131-4639-4694.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4639-4694.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Basalt Monolith to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Basalt Monolith triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {C}{C}{C}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

338-1495.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Triskelion lifelink.
338-1495.description:
Give Triskelion lifelink.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Triskelion's lifelink ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
